token.title: GitHub token
token.description: Paste a GitHub OAuth token of the Copilot user, for example the output of `gh auth token`.

billing.title: GitHub billing API
billing.description: Use a fine-grained personal access token with the **Plan: read** user permission (for an organisation: a token with **Administration: read** on the org). Leave the name empty to use the token owner.

reauth_confirm.description: The stored GitHub token no longer works. Continue to sign in again.
